title: What was the fastest lap speed among all drivers in the 2009 Spanish Grand
question:
What was the fastest lap speed among all drivers in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the fastest lap speed among all refers to max(fastestLapSpeed); Spanish Grand Prix refers to races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT MAX(lt.XCL_048) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
JOIN seasons s ON r.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
WHERE s.XCL_092 = '2009'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT MAX(CAST(r.XCL_089 AS REAL)) AS fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND ra.XCL_066 = 2009;
